test_title: PYST 44 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: P, Q and R working alone can complete a work in 15, 20 and 30 days respectively. All three of them started the work together but after 4 days P left the work. Q left the work 6 days before the work was completed. R completed the remaining work alone. In how many days was the total work completed?
solution:
**Given:**

P = 15 days

Q = 20 days

R = 30 days

P leaves after 4 days

Q leaves 6 days before completion

**Formula Used:**

Work = LCM

Work done = rate × time

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 15, 20, 30 = 60

⇒ P one day work = 60 ÷ 15 = 4

⇒ Q one day work = 60 ÷ 20 = 3

⇒ R one day work = 60 ÷ 30 = 2

⇒ Let total time = x

⇒ P works for 4 days

⇒ Q works for (x - 6) days

⇒ R works for x days

⇒ Total work = 60

⇒ 4 × 4 + 3 × (x - 6) + 2 × x = 60

⇒ 16 + 3x - 18 + 2x = 60

⇒ 5x - 2 = 60

⇒ 5x = 62

⇒ x = 62 ÷ 5

**∴ The correct answer is 62/5 days.**
